## Why

What changes for the user of this repository if this EPIC lands, and what stays broken if
it does not. One short paragraph, no restatement of the issue template.

## Scope

Bullets. Be explicit about what is included.

- [ ]

## Out of scope

Bullets. Say what you are deliberately not doing, so "why isn't this included?" never has
to be asked.

- [ ]

Each line must end with the command that proves it.

## Child issues

Keep this list current. The EPIC does not close unless every child is closed.

## Risks / open questions

Known unknowns at planning time. Anything unresolved here must be resolved before close,
not silently dropped.
